selection_reason: S003 provides the module interface signals, establishing port context for internal declarations.
S004 lists all required registers (text_in_r, sa, dcnt, kb, kcnt, ld_r, text_out) with their widths and reset values, essential for declaring the register set.

S005 explicitly specifies the submodule names (aes_key_expand_128, aes_inv_sbox), the exact number of sbox instances (16), and the naming convention (us00‑us33), which are all that is needed to correctly instantiate and label submodules.
S007 defines the basic inverse round transformations (InvShiftRows, InvSubBytes, InvMixColumns, AddRoundKey) and the InvMixColumns matrix coefficients (0E, 0B, 0D, 09) needed for GF multiplications.
S011 provides the concrete combinational implementation mapping for each transformation, including shift wire assignments and the production of sa_ark and sa_next.
S012 describes how to select the current round key from the kb buffer using the round counter dcnt, directly needed for the AddRoundKey step.
S013 details the final output mapping from sa_ark to the 128‑bit output candidate in column‑major order, required to generate output_map.
S004 enumerates all registers and their characteristics, dictating which storage elements must be updated on clock edges.
S008 contains the complete FSM state transition diagram and state names (IDLE, KeyLoad, …, Done) required to implement the state machine.
S009 specifies the behavior of the round counter (dcnt), key‑buffer counter (kcnt), the go signal, and the done signal assertion logic.
S010 describes the initial data loading procedure (text_in_r capture, sa initialization via XOR with kb[10], and the ld_r flag), which directly informs the sequential updates.
S012 defines the key buffer storage process, including kcnt decrement and the capture of wk3‑wk0 into kb[kcnt], essential for key schedule loading.
S013 defines the output capture timing (updating text_out from output_map on Done state) needed to complete the sequential register update logic.
